goalAndScope.intendedApplication: Quantify environmental impacts across the full value chain for standardised sustainability disclosures.
goalAndScope.reasonsForStudy: To quantify the carbon footprint and environmental impact of this product in accordance with ISO 14044/14067.
goalAndScope.cutOffCriteria: Mass: <1% of total input mass. Energy: <1% of total energy input. Environmental significance: any flow contributing >1% to any impact category is included regardless of mass/energy contribution.

allocation.procedure: Physical allocation by mass is applied for all co-products following the ISO 14044 Clause 4.3.4 hierarchy. Mass-based physical allocation was used throughout; no economic allocation was applied.

uncertainty.methodologyNotes: Uncertainty propagation follows the root-sum-of-squares approach for geometric standard deviation per Frischknecht et al. (2007), using the Pedigree Matrix for data quality scoring. Sensitivity analysis applies +/-20% variation to emission factors of the top three contributors.

criticalReview.notes: Critical review NOT CONDUCTED. A critical review per ISO 14044 §6 is recommended before this study is used for public comparative assertions.

interpretation.significantIssues: The most significant contributors to the carbon footprint are Glass 60ml Bottle, Pineapple Juice NFC and Lemon Juice NFC, collectively accounting for 68.0% of the total impact. The packaging stage dominates at 59.5%.
keyFindings: The total carbon footprint is 0.087 kg CO2e per functional unit.
Glass 60ml Bottle is the largest single contributor at 38.1% of the total.
The packaging stage accounts for over half the total impact (59.5%).
limitations: Data quality compliance gaps identified: 1 issue(s).
Secondary LCI data (ecoinvent, AGRIBALYSE, DEFRA) represents average technology and conditions; site-specific primary data would improve accuracy.
recommendations: Prioritise supplier engagement for Glass 60ml Bottle to obtain primary verified data and reduce uncertainty.
Improve data quality for highly sensitive parameters (Glass 60ml Bottle) to strengthen result robustness.
Conduct a third-party critical review per ISO 14044 §6 before using this study for public comparative assertions.
